# Before the Curtain: The Storm Costume

At three o’clock, the school hall smelled of dust, warm paint, and the oranges someone had packed for the cast. Ada had been asked to help in the costume cupboard because she remembered where everything belonged. She liked being trusted with the list and the keys. Jo came in carrying a folded script. “They promised me Storm,” she said. “I learned the lines on the bus.” On the rail, Jo found a gold tunic marked MOON. She tried it over her shirt; it pulled tight at the shoulders. Ada found a handwritten label underneath: JO—STORM, crossed out in blue pen.

“Maybe they changed the casting,” Ada said, though the page still listed Jo as Storm. Jo looked at the tunic’s narrow seam. “They didn’t tell me.” She wasn’t crying; she sounded much more annoyed than that. Ada knew the feeling. For weeks she had been trusted to cue the wind in the play, and she wanted the show to work exactly as rehearsed. “I can find Mrs Bell,” she said. Jo handed her the script. “Ask why first. Don’t ask them to give me some other part.” Ada nodded. She put the script on the counter, not in the pile marked returned.

A mirror leaned against a box of paper stars. Its glass was hazy with fingerprints. Ada wiped one clean patch with her sleeve, and Jo stood there holding up the gold tunic. In the mirror, the label on the rail was visible over Jo’s shoulder: STORM, then the blue line through her name. “I look like the Moon,” Jo said. “A very uncomfortable moon.” Ada laughed, then stopped. “You still want to play Storm?” “More than I want to wear this.” Jo’s answer was quick. Ada felt relieved that she didn’t have to guess what help meant.

On a nearby hook hung a long black cape from last year’s play. Ada borrowed it from the cupboard, careful to write her name on the return card. She held it out and Jo swept one corner through the air. It made a soft, convincing rush. “That’s the wind cue,” Ada said. “You could wear it.” Jo shook her head. “You need it for your cue. If you give it to me, you’re the one who loses something.” Ada had planned to carry it herself anyway. She tried it once more, this time making a gust that lifted the paper stars. Jo smiled despite herself.

A loose silver ribbon lay in the notions drawer. Jo tied it to the cape’s clasp, not to the tunic. “So the storm has a little moonlight,” she said. The detail was small, but it was her choice. Ada checked the clock. Mrs Bell was helping the younger class with their painted scenery, and the first audience would arrive soon. “I’ll go ask.” “Ask,” Jo repeated. “Not decide for me.” Ada promised she would come straight back with an answer, even if it was an answer neither of them liked.

Mrs Bell appeared in the doorway, holding a stack of scenery boards. Ada showed her the crossed-out label and asked about the storm costume. Mrs Bell frowned. “The right coat is still in the assembly hall. I sent someone for it, but it may not get here before places.” Jo didn’t hide behind Ada. “I was promised Storm,” she said. “The tunic hurts, and I’m not changing parts without being asked.” Mrs Bell apologized for the label, then hurried back to the hall. The promised coat might still come, but no one could make it arrive by wishing.

Ada and Jo examined the tunic. One seam had a little allowance, but the pin tin was empty. Ada began, “If we just—” Jo pulled the fabric away from her shoulder. “No pinning me into it. I want to be in the play, not pretend it fits.” Ada’s hands stopped. She had wanted to fix the problem quickly, before the cue list became late. Now she saw that a tidy costume was not the same as helping Jo. “Then we keep your part,” she said. “We change how the storm looks.” Jo looked at the cape, then at Ada. “Together?” “Together.”

They moved behind the side curtain to rehearse. Ada held the borrowed cape by its corners, and Jo stood on the other side. The work lamp threw their shapes onto a blank scenery cloth. Jo spoke her Storm lines from behind the moving black shape, deepening her voice on the thunder words. Ada swept the cape once, then waited for Jo’s cue instead of guessing. The silver ribbon flashed at the clasp. It was not the costume they had expected, but the wind had somewhere to go, and Jo’s voice filled the space.

When the play began, the Moon crossed the painted sky in its proper gold tunic. Then the stage went quiet. Jo’s voice said, “Listen—the weather is turning.” Ada raised the cape. Its shadow rolled across the scenery, and the silver ribbon caught the work light like a thin lightning streak. Jo spoke the Storm’s lines, clear and steady. From the front row, Mrs Bell watched with both hands clasped. Ada remembered to let Jo’s words lead the wind.

After the final bow, Jo came offstage grinning. “That was Storm,” she said. “It was,” Ada answered. Mrs Bell apologized again, this time without making an excuse, and promised to correct the cast list before the next performance. Ada carried the cape back to its hook; it had done real work for the scene, and she returned it with the ribbon safely untied. Jo put the script in her own bag. “Next time,” she said, “we check the label together.” Ada handed her the silver ribbon to keep. The curtain was down, but Jo had not been made smaller to fit the wrong costume.

"""The Storm Costume: a self-contained, offline mini-adventure pack."""

from copy import deepcopy
from dataclasses import asdict
import json
import subprocess
import sys
import unittest

from storyscenes.runtime import StoryError
from .world import Parameters, SCENES, generate, guard, initial, play_scene, replay, validate


OPTIONAL = {"mirror_vignette", "ribbon_vignette"}


class StormCostumeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_row_replays(self, row):
        p = Parameters(**row["parameters"])
        episodes = replay(p, row["path"])
        serialized = [asdict(e) | {"events": list(e.events)} for e in episodes]
        self.assertEqual(serialized, row["episodes"])
        self.assertEqual(episodes[-1].after, row["final_state"])
        self.assertEqual("\n\n".join(e.text for e in episodes), row["story"])
        self.assertEqual(len(row["path"]), row["scene_count"])
        self.assertEqual(len(set(row["path"])), len(row["path"]))
        state = initial(p)
        for episode in episodes:
            self.assertEqual(state, episode.before)
            self.assertTrue(guard(episode.id, state))
            for event in episode.events:
                self.assertTrue(event["action"])
                self.assertTrue(event["changes"])
                for key, value in event["requires"].items():
                    self.assertEqual(state[key], value)
                for key, changes in event["changes"].items():
                    self.assertEqual(state[key], changes["before"])
                    self.assertNotEqual(changes["before"], changes["after"])
                    state[key] = changes["after"]
                validate(state)
            self.assertEqual(state, episode.after)
            words = len(episode.text.split())
            self.assertGreaterEqual(words, 40)
            self.assertLessEqual(words, 70)
        self.assertIs(row["final_state"]["story.ended"], True)
        self.assertTrue(row["final_state"]["story.outcome"])

    def test_both_lengths_over_one_hundred_seeds_and_exact_replay(self):
        for seed in range(100):
            for count in (7, 8):
                with self.subTest(seed=seed, count=count):
                    row = generate(seed, count=count)
                    self.assert_row_replays(row)
                    self.assertEqual(set(row["path"]) & {"ending_fit", "ending_improvised"},
                                     {row["path"][-1]})

    def test_optional_vignettes_are_optional_and_have_no_offstage_effects(self):
        p = Parameters()
        seven = generate(4, count=7, params=p)
        eight = generate(4, count=8, params=p)
        self.assertFalse(set(seven["path"]) & OPTIONAL)
        self.assertEqual(len(set(eight["path"]) & OPTIONAL), 1)
        start = initial(p)
        after_opening = play_scene(p, start, "opening").after
        saved = deepcopy(after_opening)
        mirror = play_scene(p, after_opening, "mirror_vignette")
        self.assertEqual(after_opening, saved)
        self.assertTrue(mirror.after["mirror.used"])
        self.assertTrue(mirror.after["jo.saw_fit_issue"])
        ribbon = play_scene(p, play_scene(p, after_opening, "borrow_cape").after, "ribbon_vignette")
        self.assertEqual(ribbon.after["ribbon.location"], "cape_edge")
        self.assertEqual(ribbon.after["cape.holder"], "ada")
        self.assertFalse(after_opening["ribbon.chosen"])

    def test_each_ending_has_an_explicit_parameter_recipe(self):
        fixed = Parameters(teacher_available=True, minutes_left=2)
        improvised = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1,
                                seam_allowance=0, pins_available=False)
        a = generate(11, count=7, params=fixed)
        b = generate(11, count=7, params=improvised)
        self.assertEqual(a["path"][-1], "ending_fit")
        self.assertEqual(a["final_state"]["story.outcome"], "storm_costume_restored")
        self.assertEqual(b["path"][-1], "ending_improvised")
        self.assertEqual(b["final_state"]["story.outcome"], "storm_reimagined")
        self.assertNotEqual(a["final_state"]["jo.performance_style"],
                            b["final_state"]["jo.performance_style"])

    def test_parameter_counterfactuals_change_the_enacted_local_play(self):
        ready = Parameters(teacher_available=True, minutes_left=2, stage_lamp=True)
        no_coat = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1, seam_allowance=0,
                             pins_available=False, stage_lamp=False)
        a = replay(ready, ("opening", "borrow_cape", "consult_teacher", "refit_costume"))[-1]
        b = replay(no_coat, ("opening", "borrow_cape", "consult_teacher", "refit_costume"))[-1]
        self.assertTrue(a.after["jo.costume_fits"])
        self.assertFalse(b.after["jo.costume_fits"])
        self.assertIn("exchange_for_fitting_storm_coat", [e["action"] for e in a.events])
        self.assertIn("decline_the_tight_tunic", [e["action"] for e in b.events])
        self.assertEqual(b.after["minutes.left"], 0)

    def test_mirror_and_stage_lamp_parameters_have_local_effects(self):
        dusty = Parameters(mirror_clear=False)
        state = play_scene(dusty, initial(dusty), "opening").after
        mirror = play_scene(dusty, state, "mirror_vignette")
        self.assertIn("wipe_cupboard_mirror", [e["action"] for e in mirror.events])
        dark_lamp = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1, seam_allowance=0,
                               pins_available=False, stage_lamp=False)
        path = ("opening", "borrow_cape", "consult_teacher", "refit_costume", "rehearse")
        rehearsal = replay(dark_lamp, path)[-1]
        self.assertEqual(rehearsal.after["jo.plan"], "storm_sail")
        self.assertEqual(rehearsal.after["cape.use"], "wind_sail")

    def test_illegal_actions_fail_without_mutating_the_caller(self):
        p = Parameters()
        state = initial(p)
        saved = deepcopy(state)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            play_scene(p, state, "borrow_cape")
        self.assertEqual(state, saved)
        opened = play_scene(p, state, "opening").after
        saved_opened = deepcopy(opened)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            play_scene(p, opened, "performance")
        self.assertEqual(opened, saved_opened)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            play_scene(p, opened, "opening")
        self.assertEqual(opened, saved_opened)

    def test_borrowed_object_and_costume_locations_remain_consistent(self):
        p = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1, seam_allowance=0, pins_available=False)
        row = generate(2, count=8, params=p)
        states = [row["episodes"][0]["before"]] + [e["after"] for e in row["episodes"]]
        borrowed = [s for s in states if s["cape.borrowed"]]
        self.assertTrue(borrowed)
        self.assertTrue(all(s["cape.holder"] == "ada" and s["cape.location"] == "ada_hands" for s in borrowed))
        final = row["final_state"]
        self.assertEqual(final["cape.owner"], "school")
        self.assertEqual(final["cape.holder"], "wardrobe")
        self.assertEqual(final["cape.location"], "cupboard_hook")
        self.assertTrue(final["cape.used"])
        self.assertTrue(final["cape.returned"])
        self.assertFalse(final["jo.wears_costume"])
        self.assertEqual(final["jo.role_performed"], "Storm")

    def test_scene_ids_and_invalid_parameters(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(SCENES), len(set(SCENES)))
        for kwargs in (
            {"seam_allowance": True}, {"seam_allowance": 3}, {"minutes_left": 0},
            {"pins_available": 1}, {"teacher_available": "yes"}, {"mirror_clear": 0},
        ):
            with self.subTest(kwargs=kwargs), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                Parameters(**kwargs)
        for count in (True, 6, 9):
            with self.subTest(count=count), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                generate(0, count=count)
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            replay(Parameters(), ("opening", "opening"))
        with self.assertRaises(StoryError):
            guard("not_a_scene", initial(Parameters()))

    def test_cli_prints_a_complete_story(self):
        result = subprocess.run(
            [sys.executable, "-m", "storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world", "--seed", "0", "--scenes", "8"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
        )
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(result.stdout.split("\n\n")), 8)
        self.assertIn("Storm", result.stdout)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# The Storm Costume

A standard-library-only, offline mini-adventure set in a school costume cupboard. Ada borrows a school cape and tries to help Jo keep the promised Storm role without forcing Jo into an ill-fitting Moon tunic. Scene actions use `storyscenes.mini_adventures.local_play.LocalPlay`; the shared engine and other packs are unchanged.

## Run it

From the repository root:

```bash
python -m storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world --seed 0 --scenes 8
python -m storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world --seed 12 --scenes 7
python -m unittest storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.test_world
python check_pack.py /path/to/repository
```

The module accepts `--seed`, `--scenes 7|8`, and `--params` with a JSON object. For example:

```bash
python -m storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world --seed 8 --scenes 8 --params '{"teacher_available":false,"minutes_left":1,"seam_allowance":0,"pins_available":false,"stage_lamp":false}'
```

The generated JSON-native result is available directly from `generate(seed, count=7|8, params=...)`. `replay(params, path)` re-enacts a compatible path and returns its episode records. Every episode records guarded local actions, equality preconditions, state changes, and prose.

## Explicit ending recipes

These recipes are independent of the random seed and work at either supported length:

```python
from storyscenes.mini_adventures.kite.world import Parameters, generate

fitted = Parameters(teacher_available=True, minutes_left=2)
row = generate(0, count=7, params=fitted)
assert row["path"][-1] == "ending_fit"

improvised = Parameters(teacher_available=False, minutes_left=1,
                        seam_allowance=0, pins_available=False)
row = generate(0, count=7, params=improvised)
assert row["path"][-1] == "ending_improvised"
```

With time and a present teacher, Jo can receive a fitting Storm coat. Otherwise, sufficient seam allowance and pins can safely alter the tunic. If neither repair is possible, Jo declines the painful costume and performs Storm through a cape-led shadow or sail. `stage_lamp` selects that local play; `mirror_clear` changes the optional mirror scene. `minutes_left`, `teacher_available`, `seam_allowance`, and `pins_available` affect the possible costume outcome. The two optional vignettes are `mirror_vignette` and `ribbon_vignette`.

## Scope and limitations

Generated stories contain exactly seven or eight compatible scenes. Seven-scene routes use the core encounters; eight-scene routes include one of the two optional vignettes. The bounded seeded search commits only selected scenes; rejected speculative routes do not alter state or appear in the trace. The cape remains school property, its wind/shadow use is recorded, and it is returned after the performance. A chosen ribbon is also returned. The scene prose is authored per encounter and conditioned on enacted outcomes, not assembled from whole-story variants.

The model deliberately abstracts a school play: it has only these two children and one teacher, no repeated scenes, and a small set of costume and lighting possibilities. Availability is represented by validated parameters rather than a general-purpose wardrobe or clock simulation. It does not attempt literary quality scoring, exhaustive physical modeling, or semantic diversity measurement.

## Tests run

No execution tools were available during this single-response authoring run. Tests were **not executed**, and no integration-check result is claimed. The included test module covers both lengths across 100 seeds, replay and trace reconstruction, invalid parameters and actions, optional-scene omission, object continuity, counterfactual outcomes, and the CLI. Run the commands above in an environment containing the supplied shared files to verify them.
